sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hello, I'm Peter. I come from Japan. I can speak a little English and French. But I can't speak Chinese. I get up at 6:00 and go to school at 7:30 in the morning. I like P.E. best at school. It is exciting. I don't like math. I think it is difficult and boring. I want to visit China. I want to learn kung fu.

My name is Jill. I come from the USA. I'm 13 years old. I go to school at 7:40 and I go home at 5:00 in the afternoon. I have lunch at school. I like music best. It is relaxing. I want to join the music club.

I'm Mark. I'm from England. I can speak English and a little French, but I can't speak Japanese. I like art and I want to join the art club. I also like math, because it is interesting and fun. I have a pen friend in China. His English name is Jack. I want to see him one day.

questions.prompt: 1. Peter can't speak ________
questions.translation: 彼得不会讲中文。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“I can speak a little English and French. But I can't speak Chinese.”可知Peter不会讲中文。故选 Chinese。

questions.prompt: 2. What subject does Jill like best?
questions.translation: 吉尔最喜欢什么科目？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“I like music best.”可知Jill最喜欢音乐。故选 Music.。

questions.prompt: 3. What club does Mark want to join?
questions.translation: 马克想加入什么俱乐部？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“I like art and I want to join the art club.”可知Mark想加入美术俱乐部。故选 The art club.。

questions.prompt: 4. Which of the following is TRUE?
options: Mark has a pen friend in Japan.
Mark doesn't like math, but Peter does.
questions.translation: 下列哪项陈述是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段最后“I want to learn kung fu.”可知Peter现在还不会功夫想去学。故选 Peter can't do kungfu.。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Do you keep a diary(日记)? Do you know keeping a diary is good for children's writing? Many scientists are studying about children's diary writing. After they study over 30,000 children aged between 8 and 16, they find something interesting. The study shows that if a child keeps a diary, he or she can write better(更好). About 27% of children who keep diaries are better writers than others of that age.

You may ask, "What should I write in a diary?" Wilson, a very popular writer of children's books from the UK, has some advice. She says, "You can write about people you love, or people you don't like. You can also write about your hopes and great dreams. And if you are really good at sports and watch a lot of games, why not write about them in your diary?" Are you ready to start to keep a diary every day?

questions.prompt: 5. The writer uses two ________ to start the topic(话题).
questions.translation: 作者用了两个问题来开启话题。
questions.explanation: 根据文章开头的两个问句“Do you keep a diary? Do you know keeping a diary is good for children's writing?”可知是用问题开篇。故选 questions。

questions.prompt: 6. The underlined word "advice" may mean(意思是) ________ in Chinese.
questions.translation: 画线词“advice”在中文里的意思可能是“建议”。
questions.explanation: 根据后文Wilson所提出的“You can write about... You can also write about...”可知是给出的建议。故选 建议。

questions.prompt: 7. Wilson tells us ________
options: how to write a good diary
what to write in a diary
questions.translation: 威尔逊告诉了我们可以在日记里写些什么。
questions.explanation: 承接上文的提问“What should I write in a diary?”，Wilson阐述了日记可以写爱的人、讨厌的人、梦想以及比赛等内容。故选 what to write in a diary。

questions.prompt: 8. The best title for the passage may be ________
options: Keeping Diaries Is Not Popular Now
Keeping Diaries Is Good for Writing
Children Aren't Ready for Keeping Diaries
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题可能是“写日记有益于写作”。
questions.explanation: 文章核心论述写日记对儿童写作能力的促进作用以及如何写日记。故选 Keeping Diaries Is Good for Writing。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 第一节 阅读下面的语言材料, 从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Three women are walking around the park together and talking about their children.

**Mrs. Lin:** I have a 15-year-old daughter, Mary. She is cute and clever. But she likes playing computer games very much. She sometimes plays computer games without having dinner. After games, she does her homework quickly. She doesn't do well in her lessons. When I talk to her, she doesn't listen to me! What can I do?

**Mrs. Liu:** My son Paul is a good boy. He is good at all the subjects. But it's really difficult to stop my son from eating snacks. He eats too many snacks. So he is not healthy. How can I help him?

**Mrs. Lee:** My 13-year-old boy, Jacky, is good at all his lessons too. But he doesn't do exercise very often. He only likes reading books and doing his homework. I want him to go out and play football and basketball. But he often says, "I only want to read my books." Can you give me some advice?

questions.prompt: 9. Why doesn't Mary do well in her lessons?
options: Because she often listens to her mother.
Because she often plays computer games.
questions.translation: 为什么玛丽在功课上表现不好？
questions.explanation: 根据Mrs. Lin的描述“she likes playing computer games very much... she does her homework quickly. She doesn't do well in her lessons.”可知是因为沉迷电脑游戏。故选 Because she often plays computer games.。

questions.prompt: 10. Which of the following is NOT true about Paul according to the passage?
options: He is good at all the subjects.
questions.translation: 根据文章，下列关于保罗的陈述哪一项是不正确的？
questions.explanation: Mrs. Liu的发言中提到Paul是个好男孩、成绩好但爱吃零食，并未提及他经常帮助别人（He often helps others）。故选 He often helps others.。

questions.prompt: 11. What does the underlined word "stop" mean in Chinese?
questions.translation: 画线词“stop”在中文里的意思是“阻止”。
questions.explanation: stop sb. from doing sth. 为固定短语，意为“阻止/制止某人做某事”。故选 阻止。

questions.prompt: 12. Why do these women worry about (担心) their children?
options: Because their children often play outside.
Because their children have some problems.
Because their children aren't friendly to others.
Because their children don't do well in their lessons at school.
questions.translation: 为什么这些女士担心她们的孩子？
questions.explanation: 三位母亲分别倾诉了孩子沉迷游戏、爱吃零食、不爱运动等成长烦恼和问题（have some problems）。故选 Because their children have some problems.。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 第二节
sections.instruction: 第二节 阅读短文, 从方框所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项, 其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
Dear mom,

13. ________ I'm very well at school. Do you want to know about my after-class time? Well, the classes finish at half past four. 14. ________ I usually go to the library and read books on Tuesdays and Thursdays. It's relaxing. I play ping-pong with my classmates on Wednesdays. 15. ________ so I don't play it well. On Fridays, I always go to the drawing club. I like drawing. I can draw dogs well now. We usually have dinner at six o'clock.

In the evening, we study in the classroom from 7:00 to 8:30. We usually do our homework. Science is difficult, but my friend Alan helps me with it. I often either listen to music or talk to my roommates (室友) before bedtime. 16. ________

Remember(记住) to pick me up (接我) at five o'clock on Friday afternoon. Best wishes!

> A. On Mondays, I always have a music class
> B. I'm happy to get your letter
> C. Then we go to bed at ten o'clock
> D. I'm not good at it
> E. It's time to go to bed

options: On Mondays, I always have a music class
I'm happy to get your letter
Then we go to bed at ten o'clock
It's time to go to bed
questions.translation: 收到你的来信我很高兴。
questions.explanation: 信件开头的问候礼貌回应，说明收到妈妈来信很开心。故选 B (I'm happy to get your letter)。

options: On Mondays, I always have a music class
I'm happy to get your letter
Then we go to bed at ten o'clock
It's time to go to bed
questions.translation: 在周一，我总是有一节音乐课。
questions.explanation: 后文按时间顺序分别交代 Tuesdays, Thursdays, Wednesdays, Fridays 的活动，因此前面交代周一（Mondays）的安排。故选 A (On Mondays, I always have a music class)。

options: On Mondays, I always have a music class
I'm happy to get your letter
Then we go to bed at ten o'clock
It's time to go to bed
questions.translation: 我并不擅长打乒乓球……
questions.explanation: 后句说“so I don't play it well”（所以我打得不好），原因是不擅长（I'm not good at it）。故选 D (I'm not good at it)。

options: On Mondays, I always have a music class
I'm happy to get your letter
Then we go to bed at ten o'clock
It's time to go to bed
questions.translation: 然后我们在十点钟睡觉。
questions.explanation: 承接前句“before bedtime”（睡觉前），交代睡觉的时间。故选 C (Then we go to bed at ten o'clock)。

sections.title: 五、完形填空
sections.instruction: 二、完形填空 阅读短文, 理解其大意, 从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Teenagers are always stressed out(紧张,焦虑) now. They are often too busy to think about their diets and exercise. The truth is that healthy 17. ________, along with regular exercise is the only way to keep fit.

During your teenage years, 18. ________ is important to give your body the energy it needs. 50% of your calories(卡路里) should come from rice, 19. ________, vegetables and fruit. You also need to 20. ________ a lot of water, six to eight glasses a day. 21. ________ water will improve your skin and give you 22. ________ hair.

Exercise can help to make you look good, feel good and be healthy. Scientists suggest that 23. ________ should spend at least 30 minutes exercising every day. When you exercise, your body produces 24. ________. It makes you 25. ________ and energetic. It can even help you 26. ________ better at night and let you pay more attention when you study in the day.

questions.translation: 健康的饮食配合规律的锻炼……
questions.explanation: 呼应前文的diets，healthy eating表示健康饮食。故选 eating。

questions.translation: 为身体提供所需的能量是很重要的。
questions.explanation: It is + adj. + to do sth. 为固定句型，it作形式主语。故选 it。

questions.translation: ……米饭、面包、蔬菜和水果。
questions.explanation: 与rice, vegetables, fruit并列提供热量的主食为面包（bread）。故选 bread。

questions.translation: 你还需要喝大量的水……
questions.explanation: 搭配water用动词drink（喝水）。故选 drink。

questions.translation: 充足的水分会改善你的皮肤……
questions.explanation: 根据上句每天6-8杯水的要求，Enough water表示充足的水。故选 Enough。

questions.translation: ……并给你健康的头发。
questions.explanation: 多喝水对身体有益，带来健康的（healthy）头发。故选 healthy。

questions.translation: 科学家建议青少年每天应至少运动30分钟。
questions.explanation: 通篇围绕青少年（Teenagers）的健康生活方式展开。故选 teenagers。

questions.translation: 当你运动时，你的身体会产生某种物质。
questions.explanation: 肯定句中表示产生某种物质用something。故选 something。

questions.translation: 它使你感到放松并精力充沛。
questions.explanation: 与energetic并列的积极情绪形容词为relaxed（放松的）。故选 relaxed。

questions.translation: 它甚至能帮助你在夜间睡得更好……
questions.explanation: at night对应的生理活动是睡觉（sleep better）。故选 sleep。

sections.title: 六、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 三、语篇填空 阅读短文, 在空白处填入一个适当单词或用括号内所给单词的正确形式填空, 使短文通顺、连贯。
sections.passage: Do you like walking? Wendy, 27. ________ eleven-year-old girl likes walking very much. Why does Wendy like walking? That's 28. ________ she thinks it is 29. ________ (relax), and it is also good for 30. ________ (she) health. "It's about 6 kilometers 31. ________ my home to school. I get up at 6:00 every morning. After 32. ________ (have) breakfast, I walk to school. I can enjoy the beautiful scenery(风景) on the way. I feel very happy. I can also think about what 33. ________ (do) or how to do the things at school on the way," says Wendy. "My father buys a new car and he wants to take 34. ________ (I) to school every morning. But I want 35. ________ (exercise) more and I hope my father can exercise, too. Now he often 36. ________ (walk) to work. After dinner, my father, my mother and I often take a walk in the park near our house. I have a happy family."

questions.prompt: 27. Wendy, ______ eleven-year-old girl...
questions.translation: 温迪，一个11岁的女孩……
questions.explanation: eleven以元音音素开头，不定冠词用an。故选 an。

questions.prompt: 28. That's ______ she thinks...
questions.translation: 那是因为她认为……
questions.explanation: That's because... 意为“那是因为……”，用于解释前句问的原因。故选 because。

questions.prompt: 29. ...she thinks it is ______ (relax)...
questions.translation: ……她认为步行令人放松……
questions.explanation: 主语it指代步行，表语用形容词relaxing。故选 relaxing。

questions.prompt: 30. ...good for ______ (she) health.
questions.translation: ……对她的健康也有好处。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词health用形容词性物主代词her。故选 her。

questions.prompt: 31. ...about 6 kilometers ______ my home to school.
questions.translation: ……从我家到学校大约6公里。
questions.explanation: from... to... 表示“从……到……”。故选 from。

questions.prompt: 32. After ______ (have) breakfast...
questions.translation: 吃过早饭后……
questions.explanation: 介词After后接动名词having。故选 having。

questions.prompt: 33. ...think about what ______ (do)...
questions.translation: ……思考该做什么……
questions.explanation: 疑问词+不定式结构（what to do）。故选 to do。

questions.prompt: 34. ...wants to take ______ (I) to school...
questions.translation: ……想每天早上带我去学校……
questions.explanation: 动词take后接人称代词宾格me。故选 me。

questions.prompt: 35. But I want ______ (exercise) more...
questions.translation: 但我想要多锻炼……
questions.explanation: want to do sth. 为固定搭配，接动词不定式to exercise。故选 to exercise。

questions.prompt: 36. Now he often ______ (walk) to work.
questions.translation: 现在他经常步行去上班。
questions.explanation: 主语he为第三人称单数，频度副词often提示一般现在时，用walks。故选 walks。

sections.title: 七、阅读与表达
sections.instruction: 四、阅读与表达 阅读短文, 然后根据内容选择最佳答案或回答问题。
sections.passage:
People in Britain enjoy their holidays in different ways. They spend a lot of their free time at home. Many of them have pets. They like playing with their pets in their free time. The most popular activity is watching TV because they watch TV for about 25 hours a week. They often record (录制) programs so that they can watch them later.

In summer, gardening is popular. And families often have a "day out" on the weekend. They often go to a festival or see a show. Young people like to go to clubs, and people of all ages like to go to the cinema.

In winter, "do-it-yourself" is popular. People make full use of their free time by repairing houses. Some free time activities are with friends. People usually ask their friends for a drink or a meal at home. More and more British people like to eat out. They spent 10 dollars each week eating outside on average(平均).

On weekends, British people like to do sports. The popular kinds of sports are soccer, horse racing, swimming, tennis and hill walking.

questions.prompt: 37. What is the most popular activity for British people to enjoy their holiday?
questions.translation: 英国人度过假期的最受欢迎活动是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“The most popular activity is watching TV...”可知看电视是最受欢迎的活动。故选 Watching TV.。

questions.prompt: 38. How do people make full use of their free time in winter?
questions.translation: 冬天人们如何充分利用他们的空闲时间？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“People make full use of their free time by repairing houses.”可知是通过修缮房屋。故选 By repairing houses.。

questions.prompt: 39. When do British people like to do sports?
questions.translation: 英国人喜欢在什么时候做运动？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“On weekends, British people like to do sports.”可知是在周末。故选 On weekends.。

questions.prompt: 40. What do you think of the ways of spending holidays in Britain? (30 words or more)
options: I think the ways of spending holidays in Britain are very relaxing and colourful. They spend time at home or out. They don't have a lot of pressure or a lot of work to do. They can do whatever they like. It is a wonderful life.
I think British people spend their holidays in very boring ways because they only sleep.
I don't like British holidays because there are too many sports to do.
Holidays in Britain are too busy for people to relax.
questions.translation: 你觉得英国人度过假期的方式怎么样？（30词或更多）
questions.explanation: 选项A对英国人丰富多元、轻松惬意的度假方式进行了客观积极的评价，符合题意与字数要求。故选A。
